<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 390 844">
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id="submitGradient" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="100%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#C393FF"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#E42A6C"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="accentGradient" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="0%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#BBFFE7"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#86FFCA"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <filter id="shadow" x="-20%" y="-20%" width="140%" height="150%">
      <feDropShadow dx="0" dy="8" stdDeviation="12" flood-color="#200E32" flood-opacity="0.18"/>
    </filter>
  </defs>

  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#F7F8F7"/>
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="328" fill="#1F4B4D"/>

  <!-- status bar -->
  <text x="22" y="26" font-family="Inter" font-size="12" font-weight="700" fill="#FFFFFF">9:41</text>
  <line x1="320" y1="21" x2="320" y2="25" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="325" y1="19" x2="325" y2="25" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="330" y1="17" x2="330" y2="25" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
  <circle cx="345" cy="22" r="4" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <line x1="348" y1="25" x2="352" y2="28" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <rect x="361" y="17" width="20" height="11" rx="3" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <rect x="363" y="19" width="14" height="7" rx="1.5" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <rect x="382" y="20" width="2" height="5" rx="1" fill="#FFFFFF"/>

  <!-- header -->
  <g>
    <polyline points="30,80 21,89 30,98" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <line x1="22" y1="89" x2="43" y2="89" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  </g>
  <text x="28" y="155" font-family="Poppins" font-size="30" font-weight="600" fill="#FFFFFF">Forgot password?</text>
  <text x="28" y="187" font-family="Inter" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#D6F0EC">No worries, we’ll help you get back in.</text>
  <path d="M286 214 C318 188 348 206 390 180 L390 328 L270 328 C275 286 270 248 286 214 Z" fill="#2E6464" opacity="0.7"/>
  <circle cx="338" cy="241" r="35" fill="none" stroke="#BBFFE7" stroke-width="2" opacity="0.8"/>
  <circle cx="338" cy="241" r="13" fill="none" stroke="#BBFFE7" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="338" y1="220" x2="338" y2="213" stroke="#BBFFE7" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="338" y1="269" x2="338" y2="262" stroke="#BBFFE7" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="317" y1="241" x2="310" y2="241" stroke="#BBFFE7" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="366" y1="241" x2="359" y2="241" stroke="#BBFFE7" stroke-width="2"/>

  <!-- form panel shadow and panel -->
  <rect x="20" y="270" width="350" height="388" rx="24" fill="#200E32" opacity="0.12"/>
  <rect x="20" y="264" width="350" height="388" rx="24" fill="#FFFFFF" filter="url(#shadow)"/>
  <rect x="44" y="288" width="68" height="6" rx="3" fill="url(#accentGradient)"/>
  <text x="44" y="331" font-family="Poppins" font-size="20" font-weight="600" fill="#200E32">Reset your password</text>
  <text x="44" y="360" font-family="Inter" font-size="13" font-weight="400" fill="#5E6272">Enter the email connected to your account.</text>
  <text x="44" y="401" font-family="Inter" font-size="13" font-weight="700" fill="#200E32">Email address</text>
  <rect x="44" y="414" width="302" height="54" rx="12" fill="#F8F8FA" stroke="#DADADA" stroke-width="1"/>
  <circle cx="67" cy="440" r="8" fill="none" stroke="#5E6272" stroke-width="1.7"/>
  <polyline points="60,440 67,440 74,440" fill="none" stroke="#5E6272" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <text x="87" y="445" font-family="Inter" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#828282">you@example.com</text>
  <text x="44" y="493" font-family="Inter" font-size="11" font-weight="500" fill="#5E6272">We’ll send a secure reset link to this address.</text>

  <g>
    <rect x="44" y="520" width="302" height="52" rx="14" fill="url(#submitGradient)"/>
    <text x="195" y="552" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter" font-size="16" font-weight="700" fill="#FFFFFF">Send reset link</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <rect x="44" y="590" width="302" height="44" rx="12" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#DADADA" stroke-width="1"/>
    <text x="195" y="618" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter" font-size="14" font-weight="700" fill="#200E32">Back to sign in</text>
  </g>

  <!-- support note -->
  <circle cx="48" cy="698" r="11" fill="#E9FFF5"/>
  <text x="48" y="702" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter" font-size="12" font-weight="700" fill="#200E32">?</text>
  <text x="68" y="702" font-family="Inter" font-size="12" font-weight="500" fill="#5E6272">Need help? Contact your workspace admin.</text>

  <!-- bottom navigation -->
  <rect x="0" y="756" width="390" height="88" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <line x1="0" y1="756" x2="390" y2="756" stroke="#E7E7E7" stroke-width="1"/>
  <g>
    <polygon points="47,783 57,774 67,783 67,795 59,795 59,787 55,787 55,795 47,795" fill="#200E32"/>
    <text x="57" y="813" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter" font-size="10" font-weight="700" fill="#200E32">Home</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <rect x="125" y="775" width="18" height="18" rx="3" fill="none" stroke="#5E6272" stroke-width="1.8"/>
    <line x1="129" y1="781" x2="139" y2="781" stroke="#5E6272" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="129" y1="786" x2="139" y2="786" stroke="#5E6272" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <text x="134" y="813" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter" font-size="10" font-weight="500" fill="#5E6272">Projects</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <circle cx="212" cy="783" r="9" fill="none" stroke="#5E6272" stroke-width="1.8"/>
    <polyline points="207,783 211,787 218,779" fill="none" stroke="#5E6272" stroke-width="1.8"/>
    <text x="212" y="813" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter" font-size="10" font-weight="500" fill="#5E6272">Tasks</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <circle cx="288" cy="779" r="5" fill="none" stroke="#5E6272" stroke-width="1.7"/>
    <ellipse cx="288" cy="792" rx="10" ry="5" fill="none" stroke="#5E6272" stroke-width="1.7"/>
    <text x="288" y="813" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter" font-size="10" font-weight="500" fill="#5E6272">Team</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <circle cx="350" cy="778" r="3" fill="#5E6272"/>
    <rect x="342" y="783" width="16" height="11" rx="5" fill="none" stroke="#5E6272" stroke-width="1.7"/>
    <text x="350" y="813" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter" font-size="10" font-weight="500" fill="#5E6272">Profile</text>
  </g>
</svg>
